description: Variation of Condition 3 (Opening Hours) attached to planning permission ref. 2016/2426, dated 21/12/2016, to allow amended opening hours. The proposed hours are to be extended from the currently approved hours of Monday to Thursday 07:00–23:00, Friday and Saturday 07:00–23:59, and Sunday 08:00–22:00, to the following: Monday to Thursday 07:00–23:59, Friday and Saturday 07:00–01:00 the following day, and Sunday 08:00–22:30.
